CustomField.formula:
IF( NOT(Is_Open_Status__c), NULL,
IF( ISBLANK(Outreach_Attempt_1__c), CreatedDate + 1,
IF( ISBLANK(Outreach_Attempt_2__c), Outreach_Attempt_1__c + 2,
IF( ISBLANK(Outreach_Attempt_3__c), Outreach_Attempt_2__c + 7, NULL ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays the date and time the next outreach attempt is due. The follow-up schedule is 24 hours after record creation, 48 hours after the first outreach attempt, and 7 days after the second outreach attempt. The field is blank when the record is closed or all outreach attempts are complete.
CustomField.label: Next Follow-Up Due
